scripts.translation:
[管家 {0}]
雇用卡普拉服务人员的合约期限为1个月，到期后需要续缴费用。
这会给公会成员带来便利。

scripts.text:
[ Butler {0}]
Do you want to visit the room where our valuables are stored?
That room is restricted to you... you are the only one with access to it.
scripts.translation:
[管家 {0}]
要去存放贵重物品的房间看看吗？
那里是您的专属房间，只有您能进入。

scripts.text:
[ Butler {0}]
If you don't open the treasure box within time limits, there is a possibility of losing it when unexpected situation occurs.
Please make sure to remember that always, Master.
So, for our guild's improvement, you must find time to collect it.
scripts.translation:
[管家 {0}]
若未能及时打开宝箱，发生意外时宝箱可能会消失。
主人，请务必牢记这一点。
为了公会的发展，请抽空领取宝箱中的物品。

scripts.text: Go into Master's room.
scripts.translation: 进入会长房间

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Butler {0}]
I'll show you the secret path. Follow me...please.
When you want to return here, please press the secret switch.
scripts.translation:
[管家 {0}]
我带您走秘密通道，请跟我来……
想回到这里时，请按下秘密开关。

scripts.text:
[ Butler {0}]
Goods are produced once a day... if you don't remove them in time, they will not be produced anymore.
Therefore, it will be better if you check up on them from time to time.
scripts.translation:
[管家 {0}]
商品每天生产一次……若不及时领取，就不会继续生产。
所以最好时常来检查。

scripts.text:
[Ringing Voice]
'Those who overcome an ordeal shows a great deal of bravery... and will find their way to another ordeal.'
scripts.translation:
[回响的声音]
“通过试炼者已证明自己的勇气...并将踏上通往下一场试炼的道路。”

scripts.text:
[Ringing Voice]
'Only the truly brave can take the test.'
scripts.translation:
[回响的声音]
“只有真正的勇士才有资格接受试炼。”
